info.name: Smart POS · All REST APIs · Isolated test
info.description: Run all folders in order, one iteration, against tests/api/compose.yml on localhost:18080. Mutates disposable data. HTTP 404 in intentional error tests is expected.

exec: if (pm.environment.get("baseUrl") !== "http://localhost:18080" || pm.environment.get("testDatabase") !== "DISPOSABLE") { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error("Select the isolated API Test environment on localhost:18080. Never use the working DB."); }

item.name: 03 · Khách hàng: menu, đặt món, hóa đơn, hủy món, gọi nhân viên

exec: pm.test("Response contract / business state", () => { pm.expect(result.id).to.eql(900001); pm.expect(result.available).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Response contract / business state", () => { pm.expect(result.orders.some(x => String(x.orderId) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderId")))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Response contract / business state", () => { const item = result.orders.flatMap(x => x.items).find(x => String(x.id) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderItemId"))); pm.expect(item.status).to.eql("REJECTED"); pm.expect(item.cancelledByCustomer).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 04 · Bếp: đọc đơn, bắt đầu nấu, trừ kho, hoàn thành

exec: pm.test("Response contract / business state", () => { pm.expect(result).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(result.some(x => x.items.some(i => i.id === 900001))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Response contract / business state", () => { const items=result.flatMap(x=>x.items); pm.expect(items.find(x=>x.id===900001).status).to.eql("DONE"); pm.expect(items.find(x=>x.id===900002).status).to.eql("DONE"); });
pm.test("Response contract / business state", () => { pm.expect(result.tableId).to.eql(900002); pm.expect(result.status).to.eql("OPEN"); });
